answer: Sybil resistance is stake-weighted, not key-weighted: an agent's vote scales with a slashable bond it locks, so splitting one purse across a thousand addresses never multiplies influence because the collateral is summed across all of them. To flip an outcome an attacker must buy a majority of that bonded capital, and one proven false attestation slashes it, leaving the cheater on a bare ledge with nothing to stand on and its standing at a nadir. Even an ivory badge of past honesty is no shield, since the loss hits current stake: attacks cost real capital, not noise.
